items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Leather armor is made up of multiple overlapping pieces of leather, boiled to increase their natural toughness and then deliberately stitched together. Although not as sturdy as metal armor, the flexibility it allows wearers makes it among the most widely used types of armor.

items.name: Buckler
items.description: This small metal shield is worn strapped to your forearm. You can use a bow or crossbow without penalty while carrying it. You can also use your shield arm to wield a weapon (whether you are using an off-hand weapon or using your off hand to help wield a two-handed weapon), but you take a –1 penalty on attack rolls while doing so. items.name: Belt Pouch
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56
Price 1 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionA typical leather or cloth belt pouch has a leather cord to cinch it shut and another to tie it to your belt. It is large enough to hold 100-200 coins or two apples.

items.name: Scarf
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 89, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19, Varisia, Birthplace of Legends pg. 15
Price  1 sp-5 gp; Weight  1/2 lb.
Category Clothing
DescriptionEntertainers often employ seductive garb and entrancing props in their performances. Scarves of colorful cloth or transparent silk, often embroidered with elaborate scenes or motifs, are favorite accessories.

items.name: Silver Drinking Stein
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 25 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionWhether it is a simple pottery cup or an elaborate drinking stein with a handle and decorative lid that flips up, this cup may be used to hold any sort of beverage. Tankards are commonly made out of clay or tin.
